text:
eva: Postmortem follow-up (INC-4822). Main ask: a rapid-feedback rollback playbook + small telemetry fixes so on-call can act faster.

mike: TL;DR: three small changes we can ship this week: 1) emit rollout.cohort_kv_miss and rollout.cohort_error_rate metrics, 2) a 2-rule auto-rollback (soft + hard), 3) a 1-pager runbook for on-call.

sylvia: i'm happy to add metrics to the rollout service. estimate ~1d to emit tags {rollout_id, flag, cohort}.

eng-oncall: ask: can the soft rule be a pause (no revert) and the hard rule revert? soft helps avoid noise.

mike: exactly. Soft: delta_error >= 1.5% or p95 +150ms for 3m => PAUSE and page. Hard: sustained for 6m OR kv_miss > 12% immediate REVERT. Default: soft auto-page, hard auto-revert for self-serve, opt-out for Dedicated.

sylvia: adding a quick YAML sketch for config we'll add to rollout service:
```yaml
rollback_rules:
  soft:
    error_delta_pct: 1.5
    p95_delta_ms: 150
    duration_m: 3
    action: pause_and_page
  hard:
    error_delta_pct: 2.5
    p95_delta_ms: 250
    duration_m: 6
    kv_miss_threshold: 0.12
    action: revert_and_page
  tenant_overrides:
    dedicated_auto_revert: false
```
will ship behind a feature flag.

eng-oncall: great. also request a tiny UI label in the console so support can see whether auto-revert is enabled per-tenant.

mike: noted, lisa on product will add that. sylvia: can you also export a CSV of flags missing `owner` and `ramp_schedule`? we need a quick outreach list.

sylvia: yes: `./tools/flag-inventory --missing-owner --missing-ramp > outreach.csv`. will run nightly until fixed.

support: we'll take the CSV and prep a short template message for customers affected by a revert. need 3 bullets + contact link.

eva: runbook draft — 3 steps for on-call: 1) check rollout.health metrics for the cohort (kv_miss, error_rate, p95), 2) PAUSE rollout if soft rule triggered; gather traces, 3) if hard rule triggers or errors persist after 6m, REVERT and notify owners + customers. add postmortem link.

eng-oncall: please add a checklist line to the runbook: confirm priming-job calendar windows (infra/jobs/priming_windows.yaml) before unpausing. we've seen false negatives.

mike: i'll open the auto-revert PR w/ the config and tests. target demo in 48h. will include a short-circuit: if cohort_kv_miss > 0.12 then immediate pause (pre-hard decision).

sylvia: metrics + CSV scheduled. will also emit a `rollout.policy_blocked_by_blackout` metric when schedules overlap priming windows.

release-bot: created task ROLLBACK-201 "rapid-feedback rollback rules" assigned to mike + sylvia + support. Shadow job `rollout-safety-shadow` queued.

mike: after PR lands, plan: (A) feature-flagged deploy, (B) 7-day shadow run against 20% mirrored traffic including priming spikes, (C) evaluate false positives and tweak thresholds.

eva: owners & due dates: (metrics + CSV: sylvia, +1d), (auto-revert PR: mike, +2d), (runbook + support template: support, +2d), (shadow run: eng-oncall, +14d). i'll add these to the postmortem follow-ups tracker and sync Friday.

support: ack and will post draft template here when ready.

sylvia: opening PRs now. linking when ready.

mike: ack. will ping if thresholds need adjustment.

eva: thanks team. if anything blocks, flag here and i'll raise with PMs.

eng-oncall: adding a recurring monthly review to surface rollout timing clusters and high kv_miss rollouts.

eva: closing loop: i'll update the incident tracker and assign calendar reminders. ping here for PR links.
